method: 45 refusals drawn by `sighting.py --sample 15 --seed 11`, 15 per axis, each page read in full by hand on 2026-08-06. A refusal is FALSE when the page already carries what the axis demanded: for the blind axis, that its figures came from a second parser it does name, or from an instrument with only one parser in the question, or that the thing the detector read as a figure is not one; for the stamp axis, that it names a tree or a binary identity, or carries no figure. Rates are per axis and reweighted to the refused population, because the strata were drawn equally and the axes are 28 / 80 / 107 of it.
